changelog:
Protects your recordings when re-syncing several meetings at once.

Your desktop transcribes one meeting at a time. If you sent more than it could hold, the phone used to quietly send its own transcript instead - and then delete the recording, because the desktop reported the meeting done. You lost both the better transcript and the audio.

Now it says the desktop is busy, asks you to try that one again in a minute, and keeps your recording.

Pair this with desktop 0.1.66, which fixes meetings longer than about two minutes failing to transcribe.
